'''Èric Cervós Noguer''' (born 18 May 1999) is an [[Andorra]]n [[tennis]] player.

Cervós Noguer represents [[Andorra Davis Cup team|Andorra]] at the [[Davis Cup]], where he has a W/L record of 7–21. He was selected to represent [[Andorra]] at the [[2017 Games of the Small States of Europe]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Seleccionats els 49 esportistes per San Marino |url=https://www.diariandorra.ad/noticies/esports/2017/05/08/seleccionats_els_esportistes_per_san_marino_115834_1128.html |access-date=29 June 2023 |work=DiariAndorra.ad |date=8 May 2017 |language=ca}}</ref>
